verdict.rationale: The Employment & Pensions practice page confirms IndusLaw advises on 'all aspects of employment law including litigation, transactional and advisory matters' and compensation structuring, which plausibly covers drafting employment agreements as part of hiring paperwork. However, there is no explicit mention of offer letters, invention-assignment agreements, or confidentiality agreements specifically as part of a documented hiring/onboarding practice. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of offer-letter drafting, invention-assignment/IP-assignment agreement templates, confidentiality/NDA agreements tied to hiring, and any documented standardized employment onboarding practice.
